snippet.title: Linsips - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Divide chaos into order! In Linsips, place two lines to split bouncing balls into four quadrants with the exact same number of balls in each.

20 levels of escalating arcade precision, powered by an authentic OPL2 FM synth soundtrack generated in real time, the same sound technology from the MS-DOS era. The entire game fits in under 600 KB on SteamOS. No bloat. No filler. Pure puzzle action with DOS aesthetics.

Free to play on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4301370/Linsips/

Developed by MILQ Games
